summary: Every round-1 issue is fixed. Brask is she/her; torment's later showings are other opponents and none assumes an earlier outcome; moonwell's up costs a cold night that every say shows and no longer gives Mana it pours away; extraction leaves you nearly dry, so the cast is possible; reflect's graze shows in every variant; and the header gives 3 against 120. The user's rule still holds on all 17 cards, and lint has 0 errors. One leftover piece of polish, below.
